note: NOT BANKED. Attempt #5. cr-v4 scored +22.2, the best of five, and was never re-tested unchanged: cr-v5 differed from it by a ban rule PLUS my own drift, and the drift is measurably what failed (hedge words in 6/36 distractors and 0/12 keys, absent from cr-v4 entirely). This slice re-runs cr-v4's brief with nothing added and nothing removed, on fresh scenarios.
rulesHeldEXACTLY: Vary the STIMULUS across items — good news, a request, a question, an offer, neutral information, a correction, an invitation, a complaint, a suggestion, an apology, a warning, a refusal-with-alternative. This is cr-v4's load-bearing change and the one measured to work.
Distractors are the correct reply to a NEAR-MISS version of the spoken line, one fact changed. No roster of distractor TYPES.
The key is relieved, accepting, factual, advisory or neutral about as often as it is rueful. 'The inconvenienced reply' must be a losing heuristic.
NO BAN LIST. cr-v5 added one and the repair it forced is what broke the batch.
whatIsNotBeingDone: Pre-flight is run and REPORTED, but it will NOT drive rewriting. That is the cr-v5 lesson: the structural check found a real surface asymmetry, and correcting it by hand introduced a semantic tell worth 25 points. Pre-flight gates; it does not author.
